leo.design: Man in his late twenties, a breath and conditioning coach: calm, grounded and quietly confident, the young instructor people follow for straight talk rather than hype. Warm, relaxed, youthful baritone, close to the microphone, easy to listen to, with a hint of a smile. He speaks plainly to one person, unhurried, with natural pauses. Light, relaxed General American English with no strong regional accent. Not spiritual, not breathy, not an announcer.
leo.sample: Welcome. Sit tall, close your eyes. Here's the plan: four rounds, four counts each side. Nothing to win today. Just get the rhythm.
leo.style: calm and grounded, talking to one person at a natural, unhurried pace, with short pauses between sentences

mira.design: Woman in her mid-twenties, a breathwork and strength coach with a grounded, self-assured presence: people follow her for clear, no-nonsense guidance that still feels warm. Youthful low-mid voice with a soft, slightly husky texture, smooth and close to the microphone, calm and confident, with a dry, understated humour. She speaks plainly and directly to one person, unhurried, with natural pauses. Light, relaxed General American English, no strong regional accent. Modern and magnetic, never sing-song. No yoga-teacher softness, no breathiness, no hype, no upspeak, no vocal fry.
mira.sample: Okay. Get comfortable, shoulders down. We're going to slow everything down for a few minutes. If your mind wanders, fine. Come back to the breath.
mira.style: calm and grounded, talking to one person at a natural, unhurried pace, with short pauses between sentences
